title: Montse matters tour review
text:
Montse matters!
We absolutely loved our tour with Montse! She was such a wonderful guide—warm, engaging, knowledgeable and clearly passionate about Barcelona. She brought the history of the Gothic Quarter and Old Town to life with fascinating stories about the medieval buildings, hidden corners and the people who shaped the city. The harbour portion was also a lovely addition.

Montse made the entire experience fun and memorable. She was a pleasure to spend time with, and we came away with a much deeper appreciation for Barcelona. We would highly recommend Montse to anyone visiting the city—yo
author: jodyhM887LL

title: Stephanie is the best guide!!
text:
Honestly, I cannot find the words to describe how good and beautiful this tour was. Without a doubt, guide Stephanie is the reason I am giving the highest rating. His knowledge of architecture and history is impressive, and the way he narrates it makes it very easy to understand. Additionally, he had an excellent disposition to answer questions, give recommendations, and provide advice to enjoy Barcelona to the fullest. 
Thank you very much!

title: Wonderful Experience Barcelona Old Town and Gothic Quarter
text: We had a wonderful guide, Stephanie,  who showed us the highlights of The Old Town and Gothic Quarter of Barcelona.  Art, history and architecture...Stephanie was an expert.
